note: CShapes holds 713 as a colony of Japan to 1945-08-14, and this date is that boundary. Restored in M53: `taiwan` begins 1949, four years later, and this relation does not say who held the ground between — the atlas names nobody for it. Under the owner’s rule of 17 September a succession may be written across a gap; the gap is named here rather than left to make the relation unwritable.
